name: Kuromine Tomoko
source:
Kou's younger sister and Karen's classmate. Usually calls Kou "Onii-chan".

An extremely capable girl who does all the household work in the absence of their parents. It can be said that her role is more of a cute mother than a younger sister.

[From [url=http://www.moon-stone.jp/product/ms19/chara.html#tomoko]character page[/url].]
